defects.title: Fake fractional cents ($1,151.93) on opening $1,200 bank balance
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R1 f12 rendered '$1,151.93' due to unrounded GSAP innerText interpolation.
defects.measured_outcome: f12 renders exact '$1,200' with integer_dollar_lock=True (verified visually in orig_r1_r2_compare.jpg and contact_sheet.jpg).

defects.title: Weak visual contrast/hierarchy on S02 negation contradiction
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R1 S02 StrikethroughReplace rendered small low-contrast text over kitchen backdrop.
defects.measured_outcome: S02 renders bold 56px editorial relation 'BALANCE ≠ SPENDABLE' in safe upper negative space with zero face overlap and reverse_whoosh synced at -0.16f.

defects.title: Duplicate inconsistent numeric counters on Bills (-$799 top + $402 bottom ribbon)
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R1 f156 displayed both top strip '-$799 / $400 left' and duplicate bottom ribbon 'AFTER BILLS $402'.
defects.measured_outcome: single_numeric_owner_verified=True; f156 shows single exact '-$800 BILLS / $400 left to spend' with zero bottom ribbon.

defects.title: Repetitive/cramped Groceries & Gas framing and identical allocation cards
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R1 compressed speaker window on S05 Groceries and risked repeating allocation styling across S03/S05/S06.
defects.measured_outcome: 9 distinct scene signatures across 5 stage modes (max_consecutive_identical_templates=1); Bills uses ivory top_strip + tracked macro, Groceries uses balanced aspect_morph_editorial (y=0.45, h=0.46), Gas uses deep forest compact_editorial_rail.

defects.title: Fake fractional cents ($102.98 / $144.06) and circular iris void on Payoff reveal
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R1 f360 displayed '$102.98' and circular frame_morph mask clipped cutaway reveal.
defects.measured_outcome: f360 displays exact '$100' ('ACTUALLY LEFT TO SPEND / from $1,200 example balance') with discrete milestone stepping, clear curved banknotes, and editorial sheet sweep entrance (f344 MAD=4.49).

defects.title: Abrupt cutaway-to-live hard cuts (f417 MAD 114.16, f533 MAD 122.43, f635 MAD 114.40)
defects.baseline_evidence: Empirical R5.R1 decoded boundary audit measured MAD 114.16 at f417, 122.43 at f533, and 114.40 at f635.
defects.measured_outcome: Decoded boundary MADs dropped to f344=4.49, f417=2.76 (-97.6%), f533=22.63 (-81.5%), f635=3.98 (-96.5%); abrupt_cutaway_jumps=0 across all 10 boundaries (verified visually in boundary_strips.jpg).

defects.title: Product asset grounding & honest conceptual disclosure for Notion dashboard / 56-page workbook
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R1 lacked a verified owner asset catalog with SHA-256, authorization, and PII redaction gates.
defects.measured_outcome: product_asset_status.json honestly reports ASSET_MISSING_CONCEPTUAL; S09 renders labeled 'CONCEPTUAL PRODUCT OVERVIEW' 3D FlipPage schematic with '56' strictly non-monetary.

defects.title: Light-leak glare washing out Olivia's face contrast at f680
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R1 f680 rendered bright amber glare directly across face and cardigan.
defects.measured_outcome: Peripheral edge-only rim glow (opacity <= 0.20) with center face transparency mask; decoded max_face_washout_luma_delta=9.12 (0 findings across 720 frames; confirmed visually in orig_r1_r2_compare.jpg f680).

defects.title: 50ms duration gate silently dropped Bills SFX cues (f152 & f166) and renumbered cue IDs
defects.baseline_evidence: Reproduced empirically in A0: cc0_cash_flick_v1_foley-card-touch (49.5ms, 2183 samples) and cc0_tick_accent_v0_data-tick (18.0ms, 794 samples) were silently dropped (13 planned -> 11 staged).
defects.measured_outcome: planned=13, staged=13, suppressed=0, blocked=0, conservation_exact=True; BOTH Bills cues scue_02_cash_flick (f152, 47.8 dB ablation) and 18ms scue_03_tick_accent (f166, 55.8 dB ablation) verified in final MP4 with immutable cue IDs.

defects.title: Transient/crest sync drift (+6.0f paper slide, +5.38f envelope slide) & +7.03 dB page_turn speech masking
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R1 audio_event_qa recorded +6.0f lag on foley-paper-slide, +5.38f on foley-card-slide, and +7.03 dB 1–4 kHz ratio on page_turn.
defects.measured_outcome: 13/13 sync PASS (paper_rustle +0.00f, envelope_slide +0.00f, page_turn +0.00f, cash_flick +0.00f, max abs lag 0.16f); 13/13 speech-band PASS (page_turn dropped from +7.03 dB to -7.93 dB).

defects.title: False-PASS audio QA (fake SNR-only ablation, >=85% threshold, asset provenance drift, priming sample overhang)
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R1 reused snr_over_codec_db as ablation, allowed >=85% pass, re-resolved assets by family/variant, and wrote 1,325,352 samples instead of exact 1,323,000.
defects.measured_outcome: Real minus-one-cue AAC-192k counterfactual ablation implemented (13/13 PASS, 45.8–55.8 dB drop); 100% pass gate enforced; immutable (asset_id, raw_asset_sha256) enforced; exact 1,323,000 duration_samples verified; Parseval FFT fixed.

defects.title: Metadata-only continuity, pre-render audio mixing & Remotion ablation cache collision
defects.baseline_evidence: R5.R1 mixed audio prior to visual render and batch_render.mjs cached selectComposition without excludeLayerRole (producing 0/18 ablation diffs when enabled).
defects.measured_outcome: Strict post-render marker barrier (audio_render_marker_barrier=REALIZED_POST_RENDER) active; batch_render.mjs keys composition cache by excludeLayerRole -> 18/18 active-window visual ablations verified in canonical run.
